needed.evidence: The left side of the road is bordered by a green fence with no space for pedestrians to walk between the fence and the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Parked vehicles and utility poles obstruct the narrow sidewalk on the right.
needed.suggestion: Implement strict parking enforcement to keep the right-hand sidewalk clear of vehicles.

needed.evidence: The sidewalk on the right appears uneven and fragmented with various utility poles and debris.
needed.suggestion: Repave the right-hand sidewalk to remove trip hazards and ensure a smooth surface.

needed.evidence: There is high crossing demand due to commercial shops on the right, but no marked or signalised pedestrian crossing is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing to allow people to safely cross the multi-lane road.
